user.title: Connect to Kameraposti
user.description: Choose the service and enter the MQTT login and password. The Home Assistant section on the Sensors page shows them exactly in this form (e.g. service cam.steels.me, login kp-2, or kp-2-3 for another Home Assistant). Each Home Assistant needs its own login: the same login in two places disconnects both.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect to Kameraposti
reauth_confirm.description: Kameraposti rejected the stored password. Create or change the MQTT password on Kameraposti's Sensors page and enter it here.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Kameraposti broker. Check your network connection and try again.
error.invalid_auth: Kameraposti rejected these credentials. Check the MQTT login and the password.
error.invalid_login: Unknown login. Type it as shown on the sensor page, e.g. kp-2 or kp-2-2 (or just the account number).
error.device_login: This is a device’s own login (e.g. a Shelly’s) and does not work for Home Assistant. Create a login for Home Assistant on the Sensors page: Home Assistant → Add another Home Assistant.

abort.already_configured: This Kameraposti MQTT login is already configured. Another Home Assistant on the same account needs its own login: Sensors page → Home Assistant → Add another Home Assistant.

sensors.title: Sensors to Kameraposti
sensors.description: Choose the Home Assistant sensors that appear in Kameraposti and alarm through Kameraposti notifications: leak, smoke, gas (also carbon monoxide detectors and CO meters: alarm from 50 ppm, clear below 35 ppm), door, window, motion, temperature and CO₂ (carbon dioxide, ppm). {limit_note} Kameraposti creates them automatically. A sensor removed in Kameraposti does not come back (Restore on its Sensors page brings it back). Cameras are chosen in Kameraposti: Home Assistant tells it all its cameras, and an alarm brings a photo and a short video. A Z-Wave leak sensor is usually "…_water_leak" and a gas sensor has gas or carbon_monoxide in its name (shown as OK / Problem). If a sensor is missing from the list, open it in Home Assistant and choose its type under Show as (e.g. Door, Window, Moisture or Motion). Only a sensor shown as Window arrives in Kameraposti as a window.

error.too_many: Your Kameraposti plan takes at most {max} sensors.
error.unknown_kind: Could not tell whether these are leak, smoke, gas, door, window, motion, temperature or CO₂ sensors: {entities}. Remove them from the list.

locked.message: Too many wrong codes: disarming is locked (15 min, a day after repeated errors). Arming still works.

code_not_set.message: Set a disarm code in Kameraposti (Sensors → Security system) so Home Assistant can disarm.

no_response.message: Kameraposti did not answer. Try again.

refused.message: Kameraposti did not accept the change.

rate_limited.message: Too many commands in a short time. Wait a moment.
